title: AgentFairBench: Do LLM Agents Discriminate When They Act?
abstract: arXiv:2606.16723v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly take actions (screening applicants, recommending credit, triaging patients), yet fairness for LLMs is still measured by grading answers. We introduce AgentFairBench, a cheap, reproducible, multi-domain benchmark for demographic disparity in the actions of LLM agents. Grounded in a companion framework, the Bias Conduction Framework (BCF, restated here), it spans three regulator-anchored domains: hiring, lending, and medical triage. Synthetic, demographic-neutral profiles are evaluated in counterfactual matched sets that vary only a name-coded race x gender signal (in the Bertrand Mullainathan tradition), under four agent scaffolds of increasing agency (direct, chain-of-thought, multi-agent deliberation, tool-augmented). A NumPy-only harness computes counterfactual flip rate, mean absolute score difference (MASD), action-rate disparity, and tool-invocation disparity, with bootstrap confide

translated_title: AgentFairBench：大语言模型智能体在采取行动时会歧视吗？
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正越来越多地采取实际行动（筛选申请者、推荐信贷、分诊病人），然而对LLM公平性的评估仍然是通过给文本答案打分来进行的。我们提出了AgentFairBench，这是一个低成本、可复现、跨多领域的基准，用于衡量LLM智能体在行动中的人口统计学差异。该基准基于配套框架——偏差传导框架（BCF，本文重述）——涵盖三个以监管为锚点的领域：招聘、贷款和医疗分诊。合成的人口中立档案在反事实匹配集合中进行评估，这些集合仅在以姓名编码的种族×性别信号上有所不同（沿用Bertrand-Mullainathan经典研究传统），并在四种智能能力递增的智能体脚手架（直接回答、思维链、多智能体审议、工具增强）下进行测试。一个仅依赖NumPy的测试工具计算反事实翻转率、平均绝对分数差（MASD）、行动率差异和工具调用差异，并提供自助法置信区间。
tldr: AgentFairBench是一个通过反事实匹配档案、在招聘/贷款/医疗分诊三个监管领域和四种智能体架构下，评估LLM智能体实际行动中人口统计学歧视的多领域基准，突破了仅靠给答案打分评估公平性的传统做法。
en_tdlr: AgentFairBench is a cheap, reproducible, multi-domain benchmark that measures demographic disparity in the actual actions of LLM agents—across hiring, lending, and medical triage under four agent scaffolds—using counterfactual matched profiles that vary only name-coded race-by-gender signals.
